The public loops use +=/-= after currency checks, while separate SafeAdd/SafeSubtract return zero on overflow and are not called here. The original operand is not updated.

Absolute checks amount<MinInt64, an unreachable condition for int64. Round returns the input for unsupported exponent and increments only when remainder exceeds half. Manager Negative directly negates.

Money.from_decimal invokes round_dp, RawMoney.from_decimal stores the Decimal and BaseOps checked_add/checked_mul reconstruct Self. Base round_with likewise reconstructs after the selected strategy.

evidence.title: Moneta cash rounding: minor-unit bracket and tie policy differ for negatives and parity
explanation: Moneta cash rounding locates increment neighbors using truncating signed integer division and always selects the higher neighbor for HALF_EVEN ties; this fails symmetric nearest/parity expectations.

For negative nonmultiples, low/high computed from a toward-zero quotient do not bracket the input. At ties HALF_EVEN shares the unconditional high branch. Constructor does not validate a positive minimalMinors. Provider literals for CNY/HKD/NZD include an extra diaeresis.

historical_publications.title: NodaMoney — Context-selected rounding can change a value at construction
explanation: Money construction applies the selected or ambient context before storing the amount. Standard rounding defaults to ToEven and, absent a decimal override, normally derives scale from currency metadata. A custom strategy can replace the amount completely, so its policy must be treated as meaningful financial input.

Constructor and rounding/context paths only. A missing context can select an ambient policy; standard rounding normally derives scale from currency. An expressly declared composing-domain policy is a separate assessment.
